title: Reema's Italian Studio — Educational Language Learning Website

requirements.text: Create a responsive multi-page React application with client-side routing for five pages: Home, Lessons, Videos, About, and Contact. Use React Router for navigation between pages.

quotes: Pages Required: 1. Home Page, 2. Lessons Page, 3. Video Page, 4. About Page, 5. Contact Page

acceptanceCriteria: Navigation bar links correctly route to all five pages
Active page link is visually highlighted in the nav
App works correctly on both mobile and desktop screen sizes

requirements.text: Implement a clean, sticky navigation bar with the channel name 'Reema's Italian Studio' as the logo/brand on the left, and nav links (Home, Lessons, Videos, About, Contact) on the right. Include a hamburger menu for mobile viewports. Add subtle Italian flag color accents (green, white, red) to the nav.

quotes: Fully responsive for mobile and desktop

acceptanceCriteria: Nav is sticky and visible on scroll
Hamburger menu appears on mobile and toggles nav links
Italian flag accent colors appear in the nav design

requirements.text: Build the Home page with: (1) a hero section with the heading 'Learn Italian Easily — Step by Step 🇮🇹', a short tagline, and two CTA buttons: 'Start Learning' (routes to /lessons) and 'Watch on YouTube' (opens YouTube channel in new tab); (2) a 'Featured Lessons' section showing 3 lesson cards; (3) a Testimonials section with at least 3 dummy testimonials from Indian learners; (4) a footer with social media links (YouTube, Instagram, Facebook). Use the Italian flag hero image as the background or accent for the hero section.

quotes: Attractive hero section with title: 'Learn Italian Easily — Step by Step 🇮🇹'

acceptanceCriteria: Hero section renders heading, tagline, and both CTA buttons
'Start Learning' routes to /lessons
'Watch on YouTube' opens a YouTube link in a new tab
At least 3 dummy testimonials are displayed with name and quote
Footer includes working social media icon links

requirements.text: Build the Lessons page with three categorized sections: 'Beginner Lessons', 'Vocabulary Lessons', and 'Grammar Lessons'. Each section contains at least 4 lesson cards. Each card must show a title, short description, and a 'Start Lesson' button. Use dummy lesson content relevant to Italian language learning (e.g., 'Italian Alphabet', 'Common Greetings', 'Numbers 1–20', 'Articles in Italian').

quotes: Each lesson card should have title, short description, and button

acceptanceCriteria: Three distinct sections are visible: Beginner, Vocabulary, and Grammar
Each section contains at least 4 lesson cards
Each card shows title, description, and a button
Cards are responsive and display in a grid on desktop, stacked on mobile

requirements.text: Build the Videos page with a grid layout of embedded YouTube video cards. Use real or placeholder YouTube video embed URLs (iframe embeds). Show at least 6 video cards in a responsive grid (3 columns on desktop, 2 on tablet, 1 on mobile). Each card should show the video embed and a title below it.
acceptanceCriteria: At least 6 YouTube video iframes are displayed
Grid adapts to 3 columns on desktop, 2 on tablet, 1 on mobile
Each video card shows the embed and a descriptive title

requirements.text: Build the About page with three sections: (1) 'Meet Your Teacher' — a teacher introduction with a placeholder avatar image, name 'Reema', and a short bio; (2) 'Our Mission' — describing the channel's goal to make Italian accessible to Indian learners; (3) 'Why Learn Italian?' — listing benefits of learning Italian with icons or bullet points.
acceptanceCriteria: Three distinct sections render on the About page
Teacher section includes a placeholder avatar, name, and bio text
Mission section explains channel goals
'Why learn Italian?' section lists at least 5 benefits

requirements.text: Build the Contact page with: (1) a contact form with fields for Name, Email, and Message, plus a Submit button. Form submission should show a success confirmation message (no backend required — frontend only); (2) a social media links section showing YouTube, Instagram, and Facebook links with icons.
acceptanceCriteria: Form renders Name, Email, and Message fields
Submit button triggers a visible success message
Form validates that required fields are not empty before submission
Social media links section is visible below or beside the form

requirements.text: Apply a consistent visual theme across all pages using the Italian flag palette: forest green (#009246), white (#FFFFFF), and red (#CE2B37) as primary accent colors on a soft neutral background (e.g., warm off-white #FAF8F5). Use elegant, readable typography (e.g., a serif display font for headings, clean sans-serif for body). Add smooth scrolling behavior globally. Include subtle Italian flag color bar or divider accents throughout the UI for a cohesive national theme.

quotes: Use colors: green, white, red (Italian theme) with soft neutral backgrounds

acceptanceCriteria: Green, white, and red accents are consistently applied across all pages
Background uses a soft neutral color, not pure white
Smooth scrolling is enabled site-wide
Typography is consistent: distinct display font for headings, readable font for body text
Italian flag accent elements (e.g., color bar, dividers) appear on multiple pages

requirements.text: Create a reusable Footer component rendered on all pages. Include: the channel name, a short tagline, navigation links, and social media icons (YouTube, Instagram, Facebook). Style the footer with a dark background and white/accent-colored text.
acceptanceCriteria: Footer appears on all five pages
Channel name, tagline, nav links, and social icons are all present
Footer has a dark background with light text
Social icon links are clickable

constraints: No backend logic or data persistence is required — all content is static/dummy data on the frontend
Do not modify files under frontend/src/hooks/ or frontend/src/components/ui/
Contact form submission must be handled entirely on the frontend (no backend canister call needed)
nonGoals: No user authentication or login system
No backend canister data storage for lessons or contact form submissions
No real YouTube API integration — use static embed URLs
No multilingual (non-English/Italian) UI support beyond Italian vocabulary in lesson content

required: Italian flag-themed decorative hero banner with subtle watercolor texture in green, white, and red gradient bands, horizontal orientation (hero-banner.dim_1200x500.png)
Friendly female teacher avatar illustration with warm skin tone, dark hair, smiling, minimal flat style on white circle background (teacher-avatar.dim_400x400.png)
Italian language learning icon set: small flat icons for alphabet, vocabulary, grammar, and pronunciation on transparent background (lessons-icons.dim_512x128.png)
